dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Make removing the `pydantic-ai-slim*` `versions: [">=2"]` ignore an explicit part of the 2.x migration ticket (halfalive-smoky-mara), or narrow it to the next major so it stops matching once the project is on 2.x.
evidence: .github/dependabot.yml:14: # Ignore pydantic-ai-slim major versions until the 2.x migration (`halfalive-smoky-mara`) lands:
pyproject.toml:133: "pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries,duckduckgo]>=1.107,<2" — the current <2 pin makes >=2 the right range today, but the rule doesn't follow the pin when it moves
The removal only depends on someone reading a comment; nothing ties the ignore range to the pyproject pin, so a stale ignore raises no error
dropped.finding: The `versions: [">=2"]` rule blocks every pydantic-ai-slim 2.x update, including minor and patch releases. The old semver-major rule would have allowed those once the project moved to 2.x. If this ignore isn't removed as part of the 2.x migration (halfalive-smoky-mara), Dependabot will quietly stop updating pydantic-ai-slim at all.
scenarios: The 2.x migration bumps the pins to >=2,<3 but nobody removes this ignore, so Dependabot never proposes pydantic-ai-slim 2.x minor or patch updates and no error shows it.
dropped.suggested_fix: Note in the halfalive-smoky-mara ticket that this ignore entry must be deleted (or changed to the next major) when the pins move to 2.x.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a note to the `pydantic-ai-slim*` ignore rule (or track it in a ticket) saying the `>=2` range must be removed or raised to `>=3` when the project upgrades to pydantic-ai-slim 2.x, so 2.x patch/minor updates are not silently blocked.
evidence: Removed line: `update-types: ["version-update:semver-major"]`. That rule was relative to the current version, so it would have kept allowing 2.x minor and patch bumps after a 2.x upgrade.
The new comment at .github/dependabot.yml:51-54 explains why the range is used. It does not say the rule must be removed or raised to `>=3` when the project adopts 2.x.
The `*` wildcard matches the bare `pydantic-ai-slim` name as well as every extras variant, so after a 2.x migration no form of the package would get Dependabot updates.
dropped.finding: The absolute ignore range `versions: [">=2"]` on `pydantic-ai-slim*` will silently block all minor and patch updates once the project moves to pydantic-ai-slim 2.x. The semver-major rule it replaces followed whatever major was current, so this is a regression in that case. Nothing in the config marks the rule as temporary.
scenarios: A maintainer manually upgrades to pydantic-ai-slim 2.x. Dependabot then proposes nothing for 2.x patch or minor releases, including ones that fix bugs or vulnerabilities, and nobody notices because the ignore rule fails silently.
dropped.suggested_fix: Extend the comment above the rule, for example: `# TEMPORARY: remove/raise this range when migrating to pydantic-ai-slim 2.x, otherwise all 2.x updates are suppressed.`
